title: Póster Comercial de Reloj de Lujo: Fotografía de Producto y Deconstrucción Mecánica
prompt: High-end vertical split commercial poster for a luxury watch brand 'Chronos'. Left side: Hyper-realistic photography of the 'Alpine Master' mechanical watch. Materials: Brushed titanium case, sapphire crystal, leather strap. Professional warm studio lighting. Right side: Stylized deconstruction of the watch into mechanical gears, springs, and rubies. Golden glowing clockwork components floating and exploding outward. Geometric grid lines and technical data overlays. Background: Deep navy blue to black gradient with carbon fiber texture. Central glowing gold divider line. Typography: Elegant serif font. Slogan: 'Time is Luxury'.
